en.description:
Make room for focus with Sudoku - a quiet puzzle break, wherever you are.

Play every puzzle offline on iPhone and iPad. No ads, no account required, and no connection needed to keep playing.

FIND YOUR CHALLENGE
Explore 100 difficulty levels, all available from the start. Enjoy an easy break or take on a more demanding board.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Use pencil notes, undo moves, erase entries and ask for hints. There’s no countdown or mistake limit. Your progress saves automatically, so you can pause and return whenever you like.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose from six colour themes with light and dark appearances. Adjust mistake highlighting, matching-number highlights and haptic feedback.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Track completed puzzles, streaks, play time and performance by difficulty. Statistics distinguish assisted completions from puzzles solved without hints.

KEEP YOUR PUZZLE CLOSE
See your session’s status with Live Activities. Use Siri and Shortcuts to resume, pause, start a puzzle or check your progress. Set an optional daily reminder when you’d like a little encouragement.

CONNECT WHEN YOU CHOOSE
Sign in to Game Center to share competitive progress and earn achievements when online. Your puzzles and local statistics remain available offline.
A little focus. A satisfying challenge. One square at a time.
en.subtitle: Logic Puzzles & Brain Training
